  2341	def normalize_phase_b_synthesis_file(env: Env, source: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any] | None, list[str]]:
  2342	    file_label = env.rel(source)
  2343	    errors: list[str] = []
  2344	    if not source.exists():
  2345	        return None, [f"{file_label}: synthesis file does not exist"]
  2346	    try:
  2347	        data = load_yaml(source)
  2348	    except yaml.YAMLError as exc:
  2349	        return None, [f"{file_label}: invalid YAML: {exc}"]
  2350	    if not isinstance(data, dict):
  2351	        return None, [f"{file_label}: top-level YAML must be a mapping"]
  2352	    candidate_id = str(data.get("candidate_id") or "")
  2353	    parameter_name = str(data.get("parameter_name") or data.get("parameter") or "")
  2354	    if not candidate_id:
  2355	        errors.append(f"{file_label}: missing required field: candidate_id")
  2356	    if not parameter_name:
  2357	        errors.append(f"{file_label}: missing required field: parameter_name")
  2358	
  2359	    origin_claims_raw = data.get("origin_claims")
  2360	    constraints_raw = data.get("constraints")
  2361	    downstream_raw = data.get("downstream_dependents", [])
  2362	    findings_raw = data.get("provenance_findings", [])
  2363	    if not isinstance(origin_claims_raw, list):
  2364	        errors.append(f"{file_label}: origin_claims must be a list")
  2365	        origin_claims_raw = []
  2366	    if not isinstance(constraints_raw, list):
  2367	        errors.append(f"{file_label}: constraints must be a list")
  2368	        constraints_raw = []
  2369	    if not isinstance(downstream_raw, list):
  2370	        errors.append(f"{file_label}: downstream_dependents must be a list")
  2371	        downstream_raw = []
  2372	    if not isinstance(findings_raw, list):
  2373	        errors.append(f"{file_label}: provenance_findings must be a list")
  2374	        findings_raw = []
  2375	
  2376	    origin_claims: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2377	    for index, claim in enumerate(origin_claims_raw, 1):
  2378	        where = f"origin_claims[{index}]"
  2379	        if not isinstance(claim, dict):
  2380	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} must be a mapping")
  2381	            continue
  2382	        for field in ("parameter", "introduced_at_stage", "introduced_at_line"):
  2383	            if claim.get(field) in (None, ""):
  2384	                errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} missing {field}")
  2385	        normalized = dict(claim)
  2386	        normalized["citation"] = validate_notes_citation(
  2387	            errors,
  2388	            file_label,
  2389	            where,
  2390	            claim.get("citation"),
  2391	            citation_field="citation",
  2392	        )
  2393	        origin_claims.append(normalized)
  2394	
  2395	    constraints: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2396	    for index, constraint in enumerate(constraints_raw, 1):
  2397	        where = f"constraints[{index}]"
  2398	        if not isinstance(constraint, dict):
  2399	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} must be a mapping")
  2400	            continue
  2401	        if not constraint.get("parameter"):
  2402	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} missing parameter")
  2403	        kind = constraint.get("constraint_kind")
  2404	        if kind not in PHASE_B_CONSTRAINT_KINDS:
  2405	            errors.append(
  2406	                f"{file_label}: {where} constraint_kind must be one of {', '.join(sorted(PHASE_B_CONSTRAINT_KINDS))}; got {kind!r}"
  2407	            )
  2408	        normalized = dict(constraint)
  2409	        normalized["evidence_citation"] = validate_notes_citation(
  2410	            errors,
  2411	            file_label,
  2412	            where,
  2413	            constraint.get("evidence_citation"),
  2414	            citation_field="evidence_citation",
  2415	        )
  2416	        constraints.append(normalized)
  2417	
  2418	    downstream_dependents: list[str] = []
  2419	    for index, stage in enumerate(downstream_raw, 1):
  2420	        try:
  2421	            downstream_dependents.append(f"{int(str(stage)):03d}")
  2422	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
  2423	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: downstream_dependents[{index}] is not a stage number: {stage!r}")
  2424	
  2425	    findings: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2426	    for index, finding in enumerate(findings_raw, 1):
  2427	        where = f"provenance_findings[{index}]"
  2428	        if not isinstance(finding, dict):
  2429	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} must be a mapping")
  2430	            continue
  2431	        for field in ("type", "severity", "summary"):
  2432	            if not finding.get(field):
  2433	                errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} missing {field}")
  2434	        citations = finding.get("citations", [])
  2435	        if not isinstance(citations, list):
  2436	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} citations must be a list")
  2437	            citations = []
  2438	        normalized = dict(finding)
  2439	        normalized["citations"] = [
  2440	            validate_optional_citation(errors, file_label, f"{where}.citations[{c_index}]", citation)
  2441	            for c_index, citation in enumerate(citations, 1)
  2442	        ]
  2443	        findings.append(normalized)
  2444	
  2445	    if errors:
  2446	        return None, errors
  2447	    return (
  2448	        {
  2449	            "candidate_id": candidate_id,
  2450	            "parameter_name": parameter_name,
  2451	            "origin_claims": origin_claims,
  2452	            "constraints": constraints,
  2453	            "downstream_dependents": sorted(set(downstream_dependents)),
  2454	            "provenance_findings": findings,
  2455	            "source_path": env.rel(source),
  2456	        },
  2457	        [],
  2458	    )

  2469	def provenance_complete_for_candidate(env: Env, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:

  2483	def ingest_phase_b_syntheses(env: Env, synthesis_paths: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
  2484	    normalized_payloads: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2485	    errors: list[str] = []

  2548	def citation_is_real(value: Any) -> bool:
  2549	    placeholder = {"", "none", "n/a", "na", "tbd", "todo", "model memory", "memory", "from memory"}
  2550	    if isinstance(value, str):
  2551	        return value.strip().lower() not in placeholder
  2552	    if isinstance(value, dict):
  2553	        flattened = " ".join(str(v).strip() for v in value.values() if v not in (None, ""))
  2554	        return flattened.strip().lower() not in placeholder
  2555	    return False

  2558	def normalize_benchmark_entries(data: Any, file_label: str) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
  2559	    errors: list[str] = []
  2560	    if isinstance(data, dict):
  2561	        entries_raw = data.get("entries")
  2562	        if entries_raw is None and any(key in data for key in ("claim", "value", "source_type", "source_citation")):
  2563	            entries_raw = [data]
  2564	    elif isinstance(data, list):
  2565	        entries_raw = data
  2566	    else:
  2567	        return [], [f"{file_label}: top-level YAML must be a mapping or list"]
  2568	    if not isinstance(entries_raw, list):
  2569	        return [], [f"{file_label}: missing list field: entries"]
  2570	    entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2571	    for index, entry in enumerate(entries_raw, 1):
  2572	        where = f"entries[{index}]"
  2573	        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
  2574	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} must be a mapping")
  2575	            continue
  2576	        candidate_id = entry.get("candidate_id")
  2577	        family_id = entry.get("family_id")
  2578	        if not candidate_id and not family_id:
  2579	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} must include candidate_id or family_id")
  2580	        if candidate_id and family_id:
  2581	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} must key by either candidate_id or family_id, not both")
  2582	        for field in ("claim", "value", "source_type", "source_citation", "obtained_note"):
  2583	            if entry.get(field) in (None, ""):
  2584	                errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} missing {field}")
  2585	        if entry.get("source_type") not in BENCHMARK_SOURCE_TYPES:
  2586	            errors.append(
  2587	                f"{file_label}: {where} source_type must be one of {', '.join(sorted(BENCHMARK_SOURCE_TYPES))}; got {entry.get('source_type')!r}"
  2588	            )
  2589	        if not citation_is_real(entry.get("source_citation")):
  2590	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: {where} source_citation must be a real URL, DOI, CODATA identifier, or textbook ref+page")
  2591	        normalized = dict(entry)
  2592	        if not normalized.get("id"):
  2593	            normalized["id"] = stable_entry_id(
  2594	                "bench",
  2595	                [
  2596	                    normalized.get("family_id") or normalized.get("candidate_id"),
  2597	                    normalized.get("claim"),
  2598	                    normalized.get("value"),
  2599	                    normalized.get("source_type"),
  2600	                    normalized.get("source_citation"),
  2601	                ],
  2602	            )
  2603	        normalized["ingested_at"] = now_iso()
  2604	        entries.append(normalized)
  2605	    return ([], errors) if errors else (entries, [])

  2608	def ingest_benchmarks(env: Env, benchmark_paths: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
  2609	    normalized_entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2610	    errors: list[str] = []
  2611	    source_paths: list[str] = []
  2612	    for path_text in benchmark_paths:
  2613	        source = resolve_input_path(env, path_text)
  2614	        file_label = env.rel(source)
  2615	        if not source.exists():
  2616	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: benchmark file does not exist")
  2617	            continue
  2618	        try:
  2619	            data = load_yaml(source)
  2620	        except yaml.YAMLError as exc:
  2621	            errors.append(f"{file_label}: invalid YAML: {exc}")
  2622	            continue
  2623	        entries, file_errors = normalize_benchmark_entries(data, file_label)
  2624	        errors.extend(file_errors)
  2625	        for entry in entries:
  2626	            entry["ingested_from"] = file_label
  2627	        normalized_entries.extend(entries)
  2628	        source_paths.append(file_label)
  2629	    if errors:
  2630	        raise SystemExit("error: malformed benchmark input:\n- " + "\n- ".join(errors))
  2631	
  2632	    data = ensure_benchmarks_file(env)
  2633	    existing_by_id = {str(entry.get("id")): entry for entry in data.get("entries", []) if entry.get("id")}
  2634	    inserted = 0
  2635	    updated = 0
  2636	    unchanged = 0
  2637	    for entry in normalized_entries:
  2638	        entry_id = str(entry["id"])
  2639	        if entry_id not in existing_by_id:
  2640	            existing_by_id[entry_id] = entry
  2641	            inserted += 1
  2642	        elif existing_by_id[entry_id] == entry:
  2643	            unchanged += 1
  2644	        else:
  2645	            existing_by_id[entry_id] = entry
  2646	            updated += 1
  2647	    data["entries"] = sorted(existing_by_id.values(), key=lambda item: str(item.get("id")))
  2648	    write_yaml(env.benchmarks_path, data)
  2649	    return {
  2650	        "ingested_benchmark_files": source_paths,
  2651	        "entries_inserted": inserted,
  2652	        "entries_updated": updated,
  2653	        "entries_unchanged": unchanged,
  2654	        "benchmark_path": env.rel(env.benchmarks_path),
  2655	    }

  2777	def parse_defense_outcomes(log_path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
  2778	    text = read_text(log_path) if log_path.exists() else ""
  2779	    outcomes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2780	    for line_no, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
  2781	        upper = line.upper()
  2782	        if "|" in line or all(token in upper for token in ("DEFEND", "CONCEDE", "PARTIAL")):
  2783	            continue
  2784	        field_match = re.search(
  2785	            r"(?i)^\s*(?:defense_verdict|verdict|outcome|finding[_ -]?\d*[_ -]?outcome)\s*:\s*(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b",
  2786	            line,
  2787	        )
  2788	        bullet_match = re.search(r"(?i)^\s*[-*]\s*(?:finding[^:]*:\s*)?(DEFEND|CONCEDE|PARTIAL)\b", line)
  2789	        match = field_match or bullet_match
  2790	        if match:
  2791	            outcomes.append({"line": line_no, "outcome": match.group(1).upper(), "excerpt": line.strip()[:300]})
  2792	    return outcomes

  2795	def record_codex_defense(
  2796	    env: Env,
  2797	    candidate_id: str,
  2798	    parameter: str,
  2799	    iteration: str,
  2800	    rc: str,
  2801	    log_path: str,
  2802	    new_session: str,
  2803	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  2804	    manifest = load_manifest(env)
  2805	    entry = (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).get(candidate_id)
  2806	    if not entry:
  2807	        raise SystemExit(f"error: unknown candidate: {candidate_id}")
  2808	    by_param = entry.setdefault("codex_session", {}).setdefault("by_parameter", {})
  2809	    record = by_param.setdefault(parameter, {"session_id": None, "log_paths": []})
  2810	    if new_session:
  2811	        record["session_id"] = new_session
  2812	    record.setdefault("log_paths", []).append(env.rel(Path(log_path)))
  2813	    record["last_iter"] = int(iteration)
  2814	    record["last_exit"] = int(rc)
  2815	    record["last_run"] = now_iso()
  2816	    outcomes = parse_defense_outcomes(Path(log_path)) if int(rc) == 0 else []
  2817	    if int(rc) == 0 and not outcomes:
  2818	        transition(entry, "defense_pending")
  2819	        save_manifest(env, manifest)
  2820	        raise SystemExit(
  2821	            f"error: defense log contains no per-finding DEFEND/CONCEDE/PARTIAL outcome: {env.rel(Path(log_path))}"
  2822	        )
  2823	    if outcomes:
  2824	        record["last_outcomes"] = outcomes
  2825	        entry.setdefault("defense_outcomes", {})[parameter] = outcomes
  2826	    transition(entry, "defended" if int(rc) == 0 else "defense_pending")
  2827	    save_manifest(env, manifest)
  2828	    return {"candidate_id": candidate_id, "parameter": parameter, "session_id": record.get("session_id"), "outcomes": outcomes}

  2989	def remove_path(path: Path) -> None:
  2990	    if not path.exists():
  2991	        return
  2992	    if path.is_dir():
  2993	        shutil.rmtree(path)
  2994	    else:
  2995	        path.unlink()

  2998	def collect_dry_run_ids(env: Env, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
  2999	    ids = set(str(k) for k in (manifest.get("dry_runs") or {}).keys())
  3000	    for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values():
  3001	        if entry.get("dry_run") and entry.get("dry_run_id"):
  3002	            ids.add(str(entry["dry_run_id"]))
  3003	    for path in (env.artifact_root / "phase_a_fragments").glob("*.yaml"):
  3004	        try:
  3005	            data = load_yaml(path)
  3006	        except (OSError, yaml.YAMLError):
  3007	            continue
  3008	        if data.get("dry_run") and data.get("dry_run_id"):
  3009	            ids.add(str(data["dry_run_id"]))
  3010	    for path in (env.artifact_root / "tmp_prompts").glob("*_phase_a_*.md"):
  3011	        if not artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
  3012	            continue
  3013	        name = path.name
  3014	        for suffix in ("_phase_a_numeric_literal.md", "_phase_a_claim_label.md", "_phase_a_graph.md", "_phase_a_existing_provenance.md"):
  3015	            if name.endswith(suffix):
  3016	                ids.add(name[: -len(suffix)])
  3017	    for directory in ("provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs", "tmp_prompts"):
  3018	        for path in (env.artifact_root / directory).glob("dryrun_*"):
  3019	            try:
  3020	                text = read_text(path)[:20000]
  3021	            except OSError:
  3022	                continue
  3023	            match = re.search(r"(?m)^\s*dry_run_id:\s*['\"]?([^'\"\s]+)", text)
  3024	            if match:
  3025	                ids.add(match.group(1))
  3026	    return ids
  3027	
  3028	
  3029	def artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path: Path) -> bool:
  3030	    if "codex_logs" in path.parts:
  3031	        return False
  3032	    if not path.is_file() or path.suffix not in {".yaml", ".yml", ".md", ".txt"}:
  3033	        return False
  3034	    try:
  3035	        text = read_text(path)[:20000]
  3036	    except OSError:
  3037	        return False
  3038	    lines = text.lstrip().splitlines()
  3039	    if lines and lines[0].strip() == "---":
  3040	        marker_lines = []
  3041	        for line in lines[1:80]:
  3042	            if line.strip() == "---":
  3043	                break
  3044	            marker_lines.append(line)
  3045	    else:
  3046	        marker_lines = lines[:40]
  3047	    marker_text = "\n".join(marker_lines)
  3048	    return bool(re.search(r"(?m)^\s*(dry_run:\s*true|dry_run_id:|non_binding:\s*true)\b", marker_text))
  3049	
  3050	
  3051	def cmd_purge_dry_run(env: Env, args: argparse.Namespace) -> None:
  3052	    manifest = load_manifest(env)
  3053	    target = args.dry_run_id
  3054	    targets = sorted(collect_dry_run_ids(env, manifest)) if target == "all" else [target]
  3055	    removed_candidates = []
  3056	    for cid, entry in list((manifest.get("candidates") or {}).items()):
  3057	        if not entry.get("dry_run"):
  3058	            continue
  3059	        if entry.get("dry_run_id") not in targets:
  3060	            continue
  3061	        for value in (entry.get("paths") or {}).values():
  3062	            if isinstance(value, list):
  3063	                for item in value:
  3064	                    remove_path(env.abs_from_rel(item))
  3065	            elif value:
  3066	                remove_path(env.abs_from_rel(value))
  3067	        removed_candidates.append(cid)
  3068	        del manifest["candidates"][cid]
  3069	    for dry_run_id in targets:
  3070	        manifest.get("dry_runs", {}).pop(dry_run_id, None)
  3071	    if target == "all":
  3072	        manifest["dry_runs"] = {}
  3073	    for directory in ("phase_a_fragments", "tmp_prompts", "provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs"):
  3074	        root = env.artifact_root / directory
  3075	        for dry_run_id in targets:
  3076	            for path in root.glob(f"{dry_run_id}_*"):
  3077	                remove_path(path)
  3078	            for path in root.glob(f"*{dry_run_id}*"):
  3079	                if path.name.startswith("dryrun_") or artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
  3080	                    remove_path(path)
  3081	        for cid in removed_candidates:
  3082	            for path in root.glob(f"{cid}*"):
  3083	                remove_path(path)
  3084	    if target == "all":
  3085	        for directory in ("phase_a_fragments", "tmp_prompts", "provenance", "reports", "defenses", "verdicts", "codex_logs"):
  3086	            root = env.artifact_root / directory
  3087	            if not root.exists():
  3088	                continue
  3089	            for path in root.iterdir():
  3090	                if artifact_has_dry_run_marker(path):
  3091	                    remove_path(path)
  3092	    data = ensure_benchmarks_file(env)
  3093	    data["entries"] = [
  3094	        e
  3095	        for e in data.get("entries", [])
  3096	        if not e.get("dry_run") or (target != "all" and e.get("dry_run_id") not in targets)
  3097	    ]
  3098	    write_yaml(env.benchmarks_path, data)
  3099	    render_fit_file(env, manifest)
  3100	    render_batches(env, manifest)

+def concept_alias_path(env: Env) -> Path:
+    return env.artifact_root / CONCEPT_ALIASES_DEFAULT
+
+
+def target_layer_path(env: Env) -> Path:
+    return env.artifact_root / TARGET_LAYER_DEFAULT
+
+
+def ensure_concept_alias_file(env: Env) -> Path:
+    path = concept_alias_path(env)
+    if not path.exists():
+        write_yaml(path, DEFAULT_CONCEPT_ALIAS_DATA)
+    return path
+

+def normalize_symbol_match_key(text: Any) -> str:
+    value = str(text or "")
+    value = value.replace("\\widehat", "widehat")
+    value = value.replace("\\hat", "hat")
+    for tex, name in GREEK_NAME_MAP.items():
+        value = value.replace("\\" + tex, name)
+    value = value.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    value = value.replace("^", "_")
+    value = value.replace("-", "_")
+    value = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", value)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", value).strip("_").lower()
+
+
+def concept_alias_lookup(alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for variant, canonical in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        canonical_text = str(canonical)
+        lookup[str(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[canonical_text] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+    return lookup
+
+
+def canonicalize_concept(value: Any, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        return "unclassified_target_parameter"
+    lookup = concept_alias_lookup(alias_data)
+    return (
+        lookup.get(text)
+        or lookup.get(normalize_symbol_match_key(text))
+        or lookup.get(normalize_family_param(text))
+        or text
+    )
+
+
+def aliases_for_canonical(canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = {canonical}
+    for variant, target in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        if canonicalize_concept(target, alias_data) == canonical:
+            variants.add(str(variant))
+    return sorted(variants)
+
+
+def target_search_variants(canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = set(aliases_for_canonical(canonical, alias_data))
+    variants.add(raw)
+    variants.add(canonical)
+    expanded = set()
+    for variant in variants:
+        value = str(variant)
+        expanded.add(value)
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", ""))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", "\\_"))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", " "))
+        if value == "L_over_a":
+            expanded.update({"L/a", "L}{a", "L\\over a", "\\frac{L}{a}"})
+        if value in {"mhat_0", "m0_hat"}:
+            expanded.update({"mhat0", "m_hat_0", "m_{\\hat 0}", "\\widehat m_0", "\\widehat m_0^{\\,2}"})
+        if value == "chi_Q":
+            expanded.update({"chiQ", "\\chi_Q", "\\chi_{Q}"})
+        if value == "Sigma0_can":
+            expanded.update({"Sigma0", "Sigma0_can", "Sigma_0_can", "\\Sigma_0", "\\Sigma_0^{\\rm can}"})
+        if value == "P0_target":
+            expanded.update({"P0target", "P_0", "P0", "P_0_target"})
+        if value == "N_Q":
+            expanded.update({"NQ", "NQ_target", "N_Q_target", "N_Q"})
+    return sorted({item for item in expanded if item}, key=lambda item: (-len(item), item))

+def strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key: Any) -> str:
+    key = str(candidate_key or "")
+    key = re.sub(r"^fit_", "", key)
+    key = re.sub(r"^stage_?0*\d+_?", "", key)
+    return key

+def plausible_parameter_names(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    values = []
+    for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+        text = str(param or "").strip()
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        if text in {"matched_fingerprint_value", "stale_output", "assert_nonzero", "assert_zero", "paragraph"}:
+            continue
+        canonical = canonicalize_concept(text, alias_data)
+        if canonical not in values:
+            values.append(canonical)
+    return values
+

+def key_rule_target(candidate_key: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, bool]:
+    key = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    for rule in alias_data.get("key_rules") or []:
+        pattern = str(rule.get("pattern") or "")
+        if pattern and re.search(pattern, key, re.IGNORECASE):
+            target = str(rule.get("target") or "")
+            if target:
+                return target, f"candidate_key rule /{pattern}/", bool(rule.get("multi_target"))
+    return None, None, False
+

+def parse_primary_target(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    candidate_key = str(entry.get("candidate_key") or entry.get("id") or "")
+    key_suffix = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    raw_target, basis, rule_multi = key_rule_target(candidate_key, alias_data)
+    resolution_confidence = "high"
+    low_reasons: list[str] = []
+    if raw_target:
+        raw = raw_target
+    else:
+        normalized_key = normalize_symbol_match_key(key_suffix)
+        matches = []
+        for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+            param_text = str(param or "")
+            candidate_forms = {normalize_symbol_match_key(param_text), normalize_family_param(param_text)}
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param_text, alias_data)
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical))
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_family_param(canonical))
+            if any(form and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(form)}(?:_|$)", normalized_key) for form in candidate_forms):
+                matches.append((param_text, canonical))
+        canonical_matches = []
+        for _raw, canonical in matches:
+            if canonical not in canonical_matches:
+                canonical_matches.append(canonical)
+        if len(canonical_matches) == 1:
+            raw = matches[0][0]
+            basis = "candidate_key matched manifest parameter"
+        else:
+            params = plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data)
+            if params:
+                raw = params[0]
+                basis = "parameter_names fallback because candidate_key was uninformative"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("key_uninformative")
+                if len(params) > 1:
+                    low_reasons.append("multiple_plausible_targets")
+            else:
+                raw = "unclassified_target_parameter"
+                basis = "no resolvable candidate_key or parameter_names target"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("no_plausible_target")
+    primary = canonicalize_concept(raw, alias_data)
+    additional: list[str] = []
+    key_patterns = alias_data.get("multi_target_key_patterns") or []
+    key_multi = rule_multi or any(re.search(str(pattern), key_suffix, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in key_patterns)
+    if key_multi:
+        for param in plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data):
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param, alias_data)
+            if canonical != primary and canonical not in additional:
+                additional.append(canonical)
+    return {
+        "raw_primary_target_parameter": raw,
+        "primary_target_parameter": primary,
+        "resolution_basis": basis or "candidate_key parse",
+        "target_resolution_confidence": resolution_confidence,
+        "low_reasons": low_reasons,
+        "multi_target": bool(additional),
+        "additional_target_parameters": additional,
+    }

+def fraction_text(value: Fraction) -> str:
+    if value.denominator == 1:
+        return str(value.numerator)
+    return f"{value.numerator}/{value.denominator}"
+
+
+def normalize_decimal_text(text: str) -> str:
+    value = text.strip().replace("_", "").replace("−", "-")
+    try:
+        decimal_value = Decimal(value)
+    except InvalidOperation:
+        return value
+    if decimal_value == decimal_value.to_integral_value():
+        return str(decimal_value.quantize(Decimal(1)))
+    frac = Fraction(decimal_value)
+    if frac.denominator <= 1000:
+        return fraction_text(frac)
+    return format(decimal_value.normalize(), "f").rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
+
+
+def normalize_extracted_value(raw: str) -> str:
+    value = normalize_literal_value(raw).strip().strip("`")
+    value = value.replace("'", '"')
+    sp_float = re.fullmatch(r"""sp\.Float\(\s*"([^"]+)"(?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)""", value)
+    if sp_float:
+        return normalize_decimal_text(sp_float.group(1))
+    sp_int = re.fullmatch(r"sp\.Integer\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)", value)
+    if sp_int:
+        return str(int(sp_int.group(1)))
+    sp_rat = re.fullmatch(r"sp\.Rational\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)", value)
+    if sp_rat:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(sp_rat.group(1)), int(sp_rat.group(2))))
+    m_rat = re.fullmatch(r"Rational\[\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\]", value)
+    if m_rat:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(m_rat.group(1)), int(m_rat.group(2))))
+    frac = re.fullmatch(r"([-+]?\d+)\s*/\s*([-+]?\d+)", value)
+    if frac:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(frac.group(1)), int(frac.group(2))))
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+\.\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", value):
+        return normalize_decimal_text(value)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", value):
+        return normalize_decimal_text(value)
+    value = re.sub(r"\s+", "", value)
+    return value
+
+
+SP_FLOAT_RE = re.compile(r"""sp\.Float\(\s*["']([^"']+)["'](?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)""")
+SP_RATIONAL_RE = re.compile(r"sp\.Rational\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)")
+SP_INTEGER_RE = re.compile(r"sp\.Integer\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)")
+M_RATIONAL_RE = re.compile(r"Rational\[\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\]")
+CLOSED_FORM_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:Sqrt\[[^\]\n]+\]|sqrt\([^\)\n]+\)|sp\.sqrt\([^\)\n]+\))(?:\s*/\s*(?:\([^)\n]+\)|[A-Za-z0-9_.*^+-]+))?"
+)
+VALUE_EXPR_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(sp\.Float\(\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"](?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)|sp\.Rational\(\s*[-+]?\d+\s*,\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\)|sp\.Integer\(\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\)|Rational\[\s*[-+]?\d+\s*,\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\]|\\frac\{[-+]?\d+\}\{[-+]?\d+\}|[-+]?\d+\s*/\s*[-+]?\d+|[-+]?\d+\.\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?|[-+]?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)"
+)
+
+
+def add_value_candidate(values: list[dict[str, str]], raw: str, rule: str) -> None:
+    normalized = normalize_extracted_value(raw)
+    if not normalized:
+        return
+    item = {"raw": str(raw).strip(), "normalized": normalized, "comparison_key": normalized, "extraction_rule": rule}
+    if item not in values:
+        values.append(item)
+
+
+def extract_values_from_rhs(rhs: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    values: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    masked = list(rhs)
+
+    def mask_span(start: int, end: int) -> None:
+        for i in range(start, end):
+            masked[i] = " "
+
+    for regex, rule, formatter in (
+        (SP_FLOAT_RE, "sp.Float", lambda m: f'sp.Float("{m.group(1)}")'),
+        (SP_RATIONAL_RE, "sp.Rational", lambda m: f"sp.Rational({m.group(1)},{m.group(2)})"),
+        (SP_INTEGER_RE, "sp.Integer", lambda m: f"sp.Integer({m.group(1)})"),
+        (M_RATIONAL_RE, "Rational[]", lambda m: f"Rational[{m.group(1)},{m.group(2)}]"),
+    ):
+        for match in regex.finditer(rhs):
+            add_value_candidate(values, formatter(match), rule)
+            mask_span(match.start(), match.end())
+
+    masked_text = "".join(masked)
+    for match in CLOSED_FORM_RE.finditer(masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(0), "closed_form")
+        mask_span(match.start(), match.end())
+    masked_text = "".join(masked)
+
+    frac_54_5 = re.search(r"(?<!\d)54(?:\s*\*[^/\n;]+)?/\s*\(?\s*5(?!\d)", masked_text)
+    if frac_54_5:
+        add_value_candidate(values, "54/5", "coefficient_fraction_54_5")
+    for match in re.finditer(r"(?:^|=|:|->|\\to|\\mapsto)\s*" + VALUE_EXPR_RE.pattern, masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(1), "relation_value")
+    for match in re.finditer(r"\\frac\{[-+]?\d+\}\{[-+]?\d+\}", masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(0), "tex_fraction")
+    return values
+
+
+def line_mentions_target(text: str, canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    normalized_line = normalize_symbol_match_key(text)
+    for variant in target_search_variants(canonical, raw, alias_data):
+        key = normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)
+        if key and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(key)}(?:_|$)", normalized_line):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def lhs_matches_target(lhs: str, canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return canonicalize_concept(lhs.strip().strip('"').strip("'"), alias_data) == canonical
+
+
+def extract_target_values_from_text(text: str, canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    source = str(text or "")
+    values: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for match in re.finditer(r"""["']([^"']+)["']\s*:\s*([^,\n#]+)""", source):
+        if lhs_matches_target(match.group(1), canonical, alias_data):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(2)))
+    assignment_re = re.compile(r"([\\A-Za-z][\\A-Za-z0-9_{}^]*)\s*(?::=|=|:)\s*([^#;\n]+)")
+    for match in assignment_re.finditer(source):
+        lhs = match.group(1)
+        if lhs_matches_target(lhs, canonical, alias_data) or line_mentions_target(lhs, canonical, raw, alias_data):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(2)))
+    if line_mentions_target(source, canonical, raw, alias_data):
+        for match in re.finditer(r"(?:=|:=|:|->|\\to|\\mapsto)\s*([^#;\n]+)", source):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(1)))
+        if any(marker in strip_stage_key_prefix(raw).lower() for marker in ("37_20", "54_5")):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(source))
+    return values
+

+def normalize_symbol_match_key(text: Any) -> str:
+    value = str(text or "")
+    value = value.replace("\\widehat", "widehat")
+    value = value.replace("\\hat", "hat")
+    for tex, name in GREEK_NAME_MAP.items():
+        value = value.replace("\\" + tex, name)
+    value = value.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    value = value.replace("^", "_")
+    value = value.replace("-", "_")
+    value = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", value)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", value).strip("_").lower()
+
+
+def concept_alias_lookup(alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for variant, canonical in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        canonical_text = str(canonical)
+        lookup[str(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[canonical_text] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+    return lookup
+
+
+def canonicalize_concept(value: Any, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        return "unclassified_target_parameter"
+    lookup = concept_alias_lookup(alias_data)
+    return (
+        lookup.get(text)
+        or lookup.get(normalize_symbol_match_key(text))
+        or lookup.get(normalize_family_param(text))
+        or text
+    )
+
+
+def aliases_for_canonical(canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = {canonical}
+    for variant, target in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        if canonicalize_concept(target, alias_data) == canonical:
+            variants.add(str(variant))
+    return sorted(variants)
+
+
+def target_search_variants(canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = set(aliases_for_canonical(canonical, alias_data))
+    variants.add(raw)
+    variants.add(canonical)
+    expanded = set()
+    for variant in variants:
+        value = str(variant)
+        expanded.add(value)
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", ""))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", "\\_"))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", " "))
+        if value == "L_over_a":
+            expanded.update({"L/a", "L}{a", "L\\over a", "\\frac{L}{a}"})
+        if value in {"mhat_0", "m0_hat"}:
+            expanded.update({"mhat0", "m_hat_0", "m_{\\hat 0}", "\\widehat m_0", "\\widehat m_0^{\\,2}"})
+        if value == "chi_Q":
+            expanded.update({"chiQ", "\\chi_Q", "\\chi_{Q}"})
+        if value == "Sigma0_can":
+            expanded.update({"Sigma0", "Sigma0_can", "Sigma_0_can", "\\Sigma_0", "\\Sigma_0^{\\rm can}"})
+        if value == "P0_target":
+            expanded.update({"P0target", "P_0", "P0", "P_0_target"})
+        if value == "N_Q":
+            expanded.update({"NQ", "NQ_target", "N_Q_target", "N_Q"})
+    return sorted({item for item in expanded if item}, key=lambda item: (-len(item), item))

+def strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key: Any) -> str:
+    key = str(candidate_key or "")
+    key = re.sub(r"^fit_", "", key)
+    key = re.sub(r"^stage_?0*\d+_?", "", key)
+    return key

+def plausible_parameter_names(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    values = []
+    for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+        text = str(param or "").strip()
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        if text in {"matched_fingerprint_value", "stale_output", "assert_nonzero", "assert_zero", "paragraph"}:
+            continue
+        canonical = canonicalize_concept(text, alias_data)
+        if canonical not in values:
+            values.append(canonical)
+    return values
+
+
+def key_rule_target(candidate_key: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, bool]:
+    key = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    for rule in alias_data.get("key_rules") or []:
+        pattern = str(rule.get("pattern") or "")
+        if pattern and re.search(pattern, key, re.IGNORECASE):
+            target = str(rule.get("target") or "")
+            if target:
+                return target, f"candidate_key rule /{pattern}/", bool(rule.get("multi_target"))
+    return None, None, False
+

+def parse_primary_target(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    candidate_key = str(entry.get("candidate_key") or entry.get("id") or "")
+    key_suffix = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    raw_target, basis, rule_multi = key_rule_target(candidate_key, alias_data)
+    resolution_confidence = "high"
+    low_reasons: list[str] = []
+    if raw_target:
+        raw = raw_target
+    else:
+        normalized_key = normalize_symbol_match_key(key_suffix)
+        matches = []
+        for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+            param_text = str(param or "")
+            candidate_forms = {normalize_symbol_match_key(param_text), normalize_family_param(param_text)}
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param_text, alias_data)
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical))
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_family_param(canonical))
+            if any(form and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(form)}(?:_|$)", normalized_key) for form in candidate_forms):
+                matches.append((param_text, canonical))
+        canonical_matches = []
+        for _raw, canonical in matches:
+            if canonical not in canonical_matches:
+                canonical_matches.append(canonical)
+        if len(canonical_matches) == 1:
+            raw = matches[0][0]
+            basis = "candidate_key matched manifest parameter"
+        else:
+            params = plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data)
+            if params:
+                raw = params[0]
+                basis = "parameter_names fallback because candidate_key was uninformative"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("key_uninformative")
+                if len(params) > 1:
+                    low_reasons.append("multiple_plausible_targets")
+            else:
+                raw = "unclassified_target_parameter"
+                basis = "no resolvable candidate_key or parameter_names target"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("no_plausible_target")
+    primary = canonicalize_concept(raw, alias_data)
+    additional: list[str] = []
+    key_patterns = alias_data.get("multi_target_key_patterns") or []
+    key_multi = rule_multi or any(re.search(str(pattern), key_suffix, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in key_patterns)
+    if key_multi:
+        for param in plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data):
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param, alias_data)
+            if canonical != primary and canonical not in additional:
+                additional.append(canonical)
+    return {
+        "raw_primary_target_parameter": raw,
+        "primary_target_parameter": primary,
+        "resolution_basis": basis or "candidate_key parse",
+        "target_resolution_confidence": resolution_confidence,
+        "low_reasons": low_reasons,
+        "multi_target": bool(additional),
+        "additional_target_parameters": additional,
+    }

+def fraction_text(value: Fraction) -> str:
+    if value.denominator == 1:
+        return str(value.numerator)
+    return f"{value.numerator}/{value.denominator}"
+
+
+def normalize_decimal_text(text: str) -> str:
+    value = text.strip().replace("_", "").replace("−", "-")
+    try:
+        decimal_value = Decimal(value)
+    except InvalidOperation:
+        return value
+    if decimal_value == decimal_value.to_integral_value():
+        return str(decimal_value.quantize(Decimal(1)))
+    frac = Fraction(decimal_value)
+    if frac.denominator <= 1000:
+        return fraction_text(frac)
+    return format(decimal_value.normalize(), "f").rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
+
+
+def normalize_extracted_value(raw: str) -> str:
+    value = normalize_literal_value(raw).strip().strip("`")
+    value = value.replace("'", '"')
+    sp_float = re.fullmatch(r"""sp\.Float\(\s*"([^"]+)"(?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)""", value)
+    if sp_float:
+        return normalize_decimal_text(sp_float.group(1))
+    sp_int = re.fullmatch(r"sp\.Integer\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)", value)
+    if sp_int:
+        return str(int(sp_int.group(1)))
+    sp_rat = re.fullmatch(r"sp\.Rational\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)", value)
+    if sp_rat:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(sp_rat.group(1)), int(sp_rat.group(2))))
+    m_rat = re.fullmatch(r"Rational\[\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\]", value)
+    if m_rat:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(m_rat.group(1)), int(m_rat.group(2))))
+    frac = re.fullmatch(r"([-+]?\d+)\s*/\s*([-+]?\d+)", value)
+    if frac:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(frac.group(1)), int(frac.group(2))))
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+\.\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", value):
+        return normalize_decimal_text(value)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", value):
+        return normalize_decimal_text(value)
+    value = re.sub(r"\s+", "", value)
+    return value
+
+
+SP_FLOAT_RE = re.compile(r"""sp\.Float\(\s*["']([^"']+)["'](?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)""")
+SP_RATIONAL_RE = re.compile(r"sp\.Rational\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)")
+SP_INTEGER_RE = re.compile(r"sp\.Integer\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)")
+M_RATIONAL_RE = re.compile(r"Rational\[\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\]")
+CLOSED_FORM_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:Sqrt\[[^\]\n]+\]|sqrt\([^\)\n]+\)|sp\.sqrt\([^\)\n]+\))(?:\s*/\s*(?:\([^)\n]+\)|[A-Za-z0-9_.*^+-]+))?"
+)
+VALUE_EXPR_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(sp\.Float\(\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"](?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)|sp\.Rational\(\s*[-+]?\d+\s*,\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\)|sp\.Integer\(\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\)|Rational\[\s*[-+]?\d+\s*,\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\]|\\frac\{[-+]?\d+\}\{[-+]?\d+\}|[-+]?\d+\s*/\s*[-+]?\d+|[-+]?\d+\.\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?|[-+]?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)"
+)
+

+def add_value_candidate(values: list[dict[str, str]], raw: str, rule: str) -> None:
+    normalized = normalize_extracted_value(raw)
+    if not normalized:
+        return
+    item = {"raw": str(raw).strip(), "normalized": normalized, "comparison_key": normalized, "extraction_rule": rule}
+    if item not in values:
+        values.append(item)
+
+
+def extract_values_from_rhs(rhs: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    values: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    masked = list(rhs)
+
+    def mask_span(start: int, end: int) -> None:
+        for i in range(start, end):
+            masked[i] = " "
+
+    for regex, rule, formatter in (
+        (SP_FLOAT_RE, "sp.Float", lambda m: f'sp.Float("{m.group(1)}")'),
+        (SP_RATIONAL_RE, "sp.Rational", lambda m: f"sp.Rational({m.group(1)},{m.group(2)})"),
+        (SP_INTEGER_RE, "sp.Integer", lambda m: f"sp.Integer({m.group(1)})"),
+        (M_RATIONAL_RE, "Rational[]", lambda m: f"Rational[{m.group(1)},{m.group(2)}]"),
+    ):
+        for match in regex.finditer(rhs):
+            add_value_candidate(values, formatter(match), rule)
+            mask_span(match.start(), match.end())
+
+    masked_text = "".join(masked)
+    for match in CLOSED_FORM_RE.finditer(masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(0), "closed_form")
+        mask_span(match.start(), match.end())
+    masked_text = "".join(masked)
+
+    frac_54_5 = re.search(r"(?<!\d)54(?:\s*\*[^/\n;]+)?/\s*\(?\s*5(?!\d)", masked_text)
+    if frac_54_5:
+        add_value_candidate(values, "54/5", "coefficient_fraction_54_5")
+    for match in re.finditer(r"(?:^|=|:|->|\\to|\\mapsto)\s*" + VALUE_EXPR_RE.pattern, masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(1), "relation_value")
+    for match in re.finditer(r"\\frac\{[-+]?\d+\}\{[-+]?\d+\}", masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(0), "tex_fraction")
+    return values
+
+
+def line_mentions_target(text: str, canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    normalized_line = normalize_symbol_match_key(text)
+    for variant in target_search_variants(canonical, raw, alias_data):
+        key = normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)
+        if key and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(key)}(?:_|$)", normalized_line):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def lhs_matches_target(lhs: str, canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return canonicalize_concept(lhs.strip().strip('"').strip("'"), alias_data) == canonical
+
+
+def extract_target_values_from_text(text: str, canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    source = str(text or "")
+    values: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for match in re.finditer(r"""["']([^"']+)["']\s*:\s*([^,\n#]+)""", source):
+        if lhs_matches_target(match.group(1), canonical, alias_data):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(2)))
+    assignment_re = re.compile(r"([\\A-Za-z][\\A-Za-z0-9_{}^]*)\s*(?::=|=|:)\s*([^#;\n]+)")
+    for match in assignment_re.finditer(source):
+        lhs = match.group(1)
+        if lhs_matches_target(lhs, canonical, alias_data) or line_mentions_target(lhs, canonical, raw, alias_data):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(2)))
+    if line_mentions_target(source, canonical, raw, alias_data):
+        for match in re.finditer(r"(?:=|:=|:|->|\\to|\\mapsto)\s*([^#;\n]+)", source):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(1)))
+        if any(marker in strip_stage_key_prefix(raw).lower() for marker in ("37_20", "54_5")):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(source))
+    return values
+

+def normalize_symbol_match_key(text: Any) -> str:
+    value = str(text or "")
+    value = value.replace("\\widehat", "widehat")
+    value = value.replace("\\hat", "hat")
+    for tex, name in GREEK_NAME_MAP.items():
+        value = value.replace("\\" + tex, name)
+    value = value.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    value = value.replace("^", "_")
+    value = value.replace("-", "_")
+    value = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", value)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", value).strip("_").lower()
+
+
+def concept_alias_lookup(alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for variant, canonical in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        canonical_text = str(canonical)
+        lookup[str(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[canonical_text] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+    return lookup
+
+
+def canonicalize_concept(value: Any, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        return "unclassified_target_parameter"
+    lookup = concept_alias_lookup(alias_data)
+    return (
+        lookup.get(text)
+        or lookup.get(normalize_symbol_match_key(text))
+        or lookup.get(normalize_family_param(text))
+        or text
+    )
+
+
+def aliases_for_canonical(canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = {canonical}
+    for variant, target in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        if canonicalize_concept(target, alias_data) == canonical:
+            variants.add(str(variant))
+    return sorted(variants)
+
+
+def target_search_variants(canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = set(aliases_for_canonical(canonical, alias_data))
+    variants.add(raw)
+    variants.add(canonical)
+    expanded = set()
+    for variant in variants:
+        value = str(variant)
+        expanded.add(value)
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", ""))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", "\\_"))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", " "))
+        if value == "L_over_a":
+            expanded.update({"L/a", "L}{a", "L\\over a", "\\frac{L}{a}"})
+        if value in {"mhat_0", "m0_hat"}:
+            expanded.update({"mhat0", "m_hat_0", "m_{\\hat 0}", "\\widehat m_0", "\\widehat m_0^{\\,2}"})
+        if value == "chi_Q":
+            expanded.update({"chiQ", "\\chi_Q", "\\chi_{Q}"})
+        if value == "Sigma0_can":
+            expanded.update({"Sigma0", "Sigma0_can", "Sigma_0_can", "\\Sigma_0", "\\Sigma_0^{\\rm can}"})
+        if value == "P0_target":
+            expanded.update({"P0target", "P_0", "P0", "P_0_target"})
+        if value == "N_Q":
+            expanded.update({"NQ", "NQ_target", "N_Q_target", "N_Q"})
+    return sorted({item for item in expanded if item}, key=lambda item: (-len(item), item))
+
+
+def strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key: Any) -> str:
+    key = str(candidate_key or "")
+    key = re.sub(r"^fit_", "", key)
+    key = re.sub(r"^stage_?0*\d+_?", "", key)
+    return key
+
+
+def plausible_parameter_names(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    values = []
+    for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+        text = str(param or "").strip()
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        if text in {"matched_fingerprint_value", "stale_output", "assert_nonzero", "assert_zero", "paragraph"}:
+            continue
+        canonical = canonicalize_concept(text, alias_data)
+        if canonical not in values:
+            values.append(canonical)
+    return values
+
+
+def key_rule_target(candidate_key: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, bool]:
+    key = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    for rule in alias_data.get("key_rules") or []:
+        pattern = str(rule.get("pattern") or "")
+        if pattern and re.search(pattern, key, re.IGNORECASE):
+            target = str(rule.get("target") or "")
+            if target:
+                return target, f"candidate_key rule /{pattern}/", bool(rule.get("multi_target"))
+    return None, None, False
+
+
+def parse_primary_target(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    candidate_key = str(entry.get("candidate_key") or entry.get("id") or "")
+    key_suffix = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    raw_target, basis, rule_multi = key_rule_target(candidate_key, alias_data)
+    resolution_confidence = "high"
+    low_reasons: list[str] = []
+    if raw_target:
+        raw = raw_target
+    else:
+        normalized_key = normalize_symbol_match_key(key_suffix)
+        matches = []
+        for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+            param_text = str(param or "")
+            candidate_forms = {normalize_symbol_match_key(param_text), normalize_family_param(param_text)}
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param_text, alias_data)
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical))
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_family_param(canonical))
+            if any(form and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(form)}(?:_|$)", normalized_key) for form in candidate_forms):
+                matches.append((param_text, canonical))
+        canonical_matches = []
+        for _raw, canonical in matches:
+            if canonical not in canonical_matches:
+                canonical_matches.append(canonical)
+        if len(canonical_matches) == 1:
+            raw = matches[0][0]
+            basis = "candidate_key matched manifest parameter"
+        else:
+            params = plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data)
+            if params:
+                raw = params[0]
+                basis = "parameter_names fallback because candidate_key was uninformative"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("key_uninformative")
+                if len(params) > 1:
+                    low_reasons.append("multiple_plausible_targets")
+            else:
+                raw = "unclassified_target_parameter"
+                basis = "no resolvable candidate_key or parameter_names target"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("no_plausible_target")
+    primary = canonicalize_concept(raw, alias_data)
+    additional: list[str] = []
+    key_patterns = alias_data.get("multi_target_key_patterns") or []
+    key_multi = rule_multi or any(re.search(str(pattern), key_suffix, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in key_patterns)
+    if key_multi:
+        for param in plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data):
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param, alias_data)
+            if canonical != primary and canonical not in additional:
+                additional.append(canonical)
+    return {
+        "raw_primary_target_parameter": raw,
+        "primary_target_parameter": primary,
+        "resolution_basis": basis or "candidate_key parse",
+        "target_resolution_confidence": resolution_confidence,
+        "low_reasons": low_reasons,
+        "multi_target": bool(additional),
+        "additional_target_parameters": additional,
+    }

+def fraction_text(value: Fraction) -> str:
+    if value.denominator == 1:
+        return str(value.numerator)
+    return f"{value.numerator}/{value.denominator}"
+

+def normalize_decimal_text(text: str) -> str:
+    value = text.strip().replace("_", "").replace("−", "-")
+    try:
+        decimal_value = Decimal(value)
+    except InvalidOperation:
+        return value
+    if decimal_value == decimal_value.to_integral_value():
+        return str(decimal_value.quantize(Decimal(1)))
+    frac = Fraction(decimal_value)
+    if frac.denominator <= 1000:
+        return fraction_text(frac)
+    return format(decimal_value.normalize(), "f").rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
+
+
+def normalize_extracted_value(raw: str) -> str:
+    value = normalize_literal_value(raw).strip().strip("`")
+    value = value.replace("'", '"')
+    sp_float = re.fullmatch(r"""sp\.Float\(\s*"([^"]+)"(?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)""", value)
+    if sp_float:
+        return normalize_decimal_text(sp_float.group(1))
+    sp_int = re.fullmatch(r"sp\.Integer\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)", value)
+    if sp_int:
+        return str(int(sp_int.group(1)))
+    sp_rat = re.fullmatch(r"sp\.Rational\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)", value)
+    if sp_rat:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(sp_rat.group(1)), int(sp_rat.group(2))))
+    m_rat = re.fullmatch(r"Rational\[\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\]", value)
+    if m_rat:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(m_rat.group(1)), int(m_rat.group(2))))
+    frac = re.fullmatch(r"([-+]?\d+)\s*/\s*([-+]?\d+)", value)
+    if frac:
+        return fraction_text(Fraction(int(frac.group(1)), int(frac.group(2))))
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+\.\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", value):
+        return normalize_decimal_text(value)
+    if re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", value):
+        return normalize_decimal_text(value)
+    value = re.sub(r"\s+", "", value)
+    return value
+
+
+SP_FLOAT_RE = re.compile(r"""sp\.Float\(\s*["']([^"']+)["'](?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)""")
+SP_RATIONAL_RE = re.compile(r"sp\.Rational\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)")
+SP_INTEGER_RE = re.compile(r"sp\.Integer\(\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\)")
+M_RATIONAL_RE = re.compile(r"Rational\[\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*,\s*([-+]?\d+)\s*\]")
+CLOSED_FORM_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(?:Sqrt\[[^\]\n]+\]|sqrt\([^\)\n]+\)|sp\.sqrt\([^\)\n]+\))(?:\s*/\s*(?:\([^)\n]+\)|[A-Za-z0-9_.*^+-]+))?"
+)
+VALUE_EXPR_RE = re.compile(
+    r"(sp\.Float\(\s*['\"][^'\"]+['\"](?:\s*,\s*\d+)?\s*\)|sp\.Rational\(\s*[-+]?\d+\s*,\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\)|sp\.Integer\(\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\)|Rational\[\s*[-+]?\d+\s*,\s*[-+]?\d+\s*\]|\\frac\{[-+]?\d+\}\{[-+]?\d+\}|[-+]?\d+\s*/\s*[-+]?\d+|[-+]?\d+\.\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?|[-+]?\d+(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?)"
+)
+
+
+def add_value_candidate(values: list[dict[str, str]], raw: str, rule: str) -> None:
+    normalized = normalize_extracted_value(raw)
+    if not normalized:
+        return
+    item = {"raw": str(raw).strip(), "normalized": normalized, "comparison_key": normalized, "extraction_rule": rule}
+    if item not in values:
+        values.append(item)
+
+
+def extract_values_from_rhs(rhs: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    values: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    masked = list(rhs)
+
+    def mask_span(start: int, end: int) -> None:
+        for i in range(start, end):
+            masked[i] = " "
+
+    for regex, rule, formatter in (
+        (SP_FLOAT_RE, "sp.Float", lambda m: f'sp.Float("{m.group(1)}")'),
+        (SP_RATIONAL_RE, "sp.Rational", lambda m: f"sp.Rational({m.group(1)},{m.group(2)})"),
+        (SP_INTEGER_RE, "sp.Integer", lambda m: f"sp.Integer({m.group(1)})"),
+        (M_RATIONAL_RE, "Rational[]", lambda m: f"Rational[{m.group(1)},{m.group(2)}]"),
+    ):
+        for match in regex.finditer(rhs):
+            add_value_candidate(values, formatter(match), rule)
+            mask_span(match.start(), match.end())
+
+    masked_text = "".join(masked)
+    for match in CLOSED_FORM_RE.finditer(masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(0), "closed_form")
+        mask_span(match.start(), match.end())
+    masked_text = "".join(masked)
+
+    frac_54_5 = re.search(r"(?<!\d)54(?:\s*\*[^/\n;]+)?/\s*\(?\s*5(?!\d)", masked_text)
+    if frac_54_5:
+        add_value_candidate(values, "54/5", "coefficient_fraction_54_5")
+    for match in re.finditer(r"(?:^|=|:|->|\\to|\\mapsto)\s*" + VALUE_EXPR_RE.pattern, masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(1), "relation_value")
+    for match in re.finditer(r"\\frac\{[-+]?\d+\}\{[-+]?\d+\}", masked_text):
+        add_value_candidate(values, match.group(0), "tex_fraction")
+    return values
+
+
+def line_mentions_target(text: str, canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    normalized_line = normalize_symbol_match_key(text)
+    for variant in target_search_variants(canonical, raw, alias_data):
+        key = normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)
+        if key and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(key)}(?:_|$)", normalized_line):
+            return True
+    return False
+
+
+def lhs_matches_target(lhs: str, canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    return canonicalize_concept(lhs.strip().strip('"').strip("'"), alias_data) == canonical
+
+
+def extract_target_values_from_text(text: str, canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    source = str(text or "")
+    values: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for match in re.finditer(r"""["']([^"']+)["']\s*:\s*([^,\n#]+)""", source):
+        if lhs_matches_target(match.group(1), canonical, alias_data):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(2)))
+    assignment_re = re.compile(r"([\\A-Za-z][\\A-Za-z0-9_{}^]*)\s*(?::=|=|:)\s*([^#;\n]+)")
+    for match in assignment_re.finditer(source):
+        lhs = match.group(1)
+        if lhs_matches_target(lhs, canonical, alias_data) or line_mentions_target(lhs, canonical, raw, alias_data):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(2)))
+    if line_mentions_target(source, canonical, raw, alias_data):
+        for match in re.finditer(r"(?:=|:=|:|->|\\to|\\mapsto)\s*([^#;\n]+)", source):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(match.group(1)))
+        if any(marker in strip_stage_key_prefix(raw).lower() for marker in ("37_20", "54_5")):
+            append_unique_items(values, extract_values_from_rhs(source))
+    return values

+def resolve_citation_source_path(env: Env, path_text: Any) -> Path:
+    text = str(path_text or "").strip()
+    p = Path(text)
+    if p.is_absolute():
+        return p
+    candidates = [
+        env.project_root / text,
+        env.repo_root / text,
+    ]
+    if text.startswith("research/pde_ledger/"):
+        candidates.insert(0, env.repo_root / text)
+    for candidate in candidates:
+        if candidate.exists():
+            return candidate
+    return candidates[0]
+
+
+def read_citation_source_line(env: Env, citation: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
+    line_no = citation_line(citation)
+    if line_no is None:
+        return None
+    source_path = resolve_citation_source_path(env, citation.get("path"))
+    try:
+        lines = read_text(source_path).splitlines()
+    except OSError:
+        return None
+    if 1 <= line_no <= len(lines):
+        return lines[line_no - 1].strip()
+    return None
+

+def target_value_sources(env: Env, entry: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    sources: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for citation in entry.get("file_line_citations") or []:
+        if citation.get("excerpt"):
+            sources.append(
+                {
+                    "source_kind": "citation_excerpt",
+                    "path": citation.get("path"),
+                    "line": citation.get("line"),
+                    "text": str(citation.get("excerpt")),
+                }
+            )
+        source_line = read_citation_source_line(env, citation)
+        if source_line and source_line != citation.get("excerpt"):
+            sources.append(
+                {
+                    "source_kind": "cited_source_line",
+                    "path": citation.get("path"),
+                    "line": citation.get("line"),
+                    "text": source_line,
+                }
+            )
+    for fragment in entry.get("modality_fragments") or []:
+        citation = fragment.get("citation") or {}
+        if citation.get("excerpt"):
+            sources.append(
+                {
+                    "source_kind": "modality_fragment_excerpt",
+                    "path": citation.get("path"),
+                    "line": citation.get("line"),
+                    "text": str(citation.get("excerpt")),
+                }
+            )
+    deduped: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen = set()
+    for source in sources:
+        key = (source.get("source_kind"), source.get("path"), source.get("line"), source.get("text"))
+        if key not in seen:
+            seen.add(key)
+            deduped.append(source)
+    return deduped
+

+def target_value_evidence(env: Env, entry: dict[str, Any], target_info: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    evidence: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    canonical = target_info["primary_target_parameter"]
+    raw = target_info["raw_primary_target_parameter"]
+    candidate_key = str(entry.get("candidate_key") or "")
+    for source in target_value_sources(env, entry):
+        values = extract_target_values_from_text(source.get("text") or "", canonical, raw, alias_data)
+        if not values and re.search(r"(?:37_20|37_over_20|54_5|54_over_5|4107)", candidate_key, re.IGNORECASE):
+            values = extract_values_from_rhs(str(source.get("text") or ""))
+        for value in values:
+            item = dict(value)
+            item["source_kind"] = source.get("source_kind")
+            item["path"] = source.get("path")
+            item["line"] = source.get("line")
+            if item not in evidence:
+                evidence.append(item)
+    evidence.sort(key=lambda item: (str(item.get("path")), str(item.get("line")), item.get("normalized", ""), item.get("raw", "")))
+    return evidence

+def target_layer_record(env: Env, entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    target_info = parse_primary_target(entry, alias_data)
+    value_evidence = target_value_evidence(env, entry, target_info, alias_data)
+    target_values = sorted({item["normalized"] for item in value_evidence if item.get("normalized")})
+    target_value_keys = sorted({item["comparison_key"] for item in value_evidence if item.get("comparison_key")})
+    low_reasons = list(target_info.get("low_reasons") or [])
+    if not target_values:
+        low_reasons.append("target_value_unresolved")
+    confidence = "low" if low_reasons or target_info.get("target_resolution_confidence") == "low" else "high"
+    basis_parts = [str(target_info.get("resolution_basis") or "candidate_key parse")]
+    if value_evidence:
+        value_sources = sorted(
+            {
+                f"{item.get('source_kind')}:{normalize_citation_path(item.get('path'))}:{item.get('line')}"
+                for item in value_evidence
+            }
+        )
+        basis_parts.append("values from " + ", ".join(value_sources[:4]))
+    else:
+        basis_parts.append("no confident target value extracted from citation/source line")
+    if low_reasons:
+        basis_parts.append("low: " + ", ".join(sorted(set(low_reasons))))
+    anchor_stages = [str(stage) for stage in entry.get("anchor_stages") or []]
+    return {
+        "candidate_id": str(entry.get("id")),
+        "candidate_key": str(entry.get("candidate_key") or ""),
+        "anchor_stages": anchor_stages,
+        "anchor_stage": anchor_stages[0] if len(anchor_stages) == 1 else "+".join(anchor_stages),
+        "raw_primary_target_parameter": target_info["raw_primary_target_parameter"],
+        "primary_target_parameter": target_info["primary_target_parameter"],
+        "additional_target_parameters": target_info.get("additional_target_parameters") or [],
+        "multi_target": bool(target_info.get("multi_target")),
+        "target_values": target_values,
+        "target_value_keys": target_value_keys,
+        "target_value_evidence": value_evidence,
+        "target_confidence": confidence,
+        "resolution_basis": "; ".join(basis_parts),
+    }
+
+
+def build_target_layer(env: Env, out_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    manifest = load_manifest(env)
+    alias_data = load_concept_aliases(env)
+    scanned_entries = [
+        entry
+        for entry in (manifest.get("candidates") or {}).values()
+        if entry.get("status") == "scanned" and not entry.get("dry_run")
+    ]
+    records = [target_layer_record(env, entry, alias_data) for entry in sorted(scanned_entries, key=lambda item: str(item.get("id") or ""))]
+    confidence_counts = Counter(record.get("target_confidence") for record in records)
+    payload = {
+        "schema_version": 1,
+        "generated_at": now_iso(),
+        "source_manifest": env.rel(env.manifest_path),
+        "concept_aliases": env.rel(concept_alias_path(env)),
+        "read_only_manifest": True,
+        "rule": {
+            "primary_target_resolution": [
+                "candidate_key key_rules from _concept_aliases.yaml",
+                "candidate_key token match against manifest parameter_names when no key_rule fires",
+                "parameter_names fallback only when the key is uninformative",
+                "concept aliases canonicalize variants to one primary_target_parameter",
+            ],
+            "target_confidence": "low when key fallback/multiple plausible targets/no confident target value; high otherwise",
+            "value_extraction": [
+                "citation excerpt and cited source line are both scanned",
+                "sp.Float/sp.Rational/sp.Integer and Mathematica Rational[]",
+                "JSON colon values",
+                "chained equality/relation values",
+                "TeX/plain fractions, decimals, and integers",
+                "closed-form Sqrt/sqrt expressions",
+                "exact decimal/fraction normalization such as 0.05 == 1/20",
+            ],
+        },
+        "summary": {
+            "scanned_candidate_count": len(records),
+            "target_confidence_counts": dict(sorted(confidence_counts.items())),
+            "value_extracted_count": sum(1 for record in records if record.get("target_values")),
+            "multi_target_count": sum(1 for record in records if record.get("multi_target")),
+        },
+        "records": records,
+    }
+    write_yaml(out_path, payload)
+    return payload
+
+
+def load_or_build_target_layer(env: Env) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    path = target_layer_path(env)
+    if not path.exists():
+        return build_target_layer(env, path)
+    data = load_yaml(path)
+    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("records"), list):
+        return build_target_layer(env, path)
+    return data
+
+
+def target_layer_by_candidate(env: Env) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
+    data = load_or_build_target_layer(env)
+    return {str(record.get("candidate_id")): record for record in data.get("records") or []}

+def normalize_symbol_match_key(text: Any) -> str:
+    value = str(text or "")
+    value = value.replace("\\widehat", "widehat")
+    value = value.replace("\\hat", "hat")
+    for tex, name in GREEK_NAME_MAP.items():
+        value = value.replace("\\" + tex, name)
+    value = value.replace("{", "").replace("}", "")
+    value = value.replace("^", "_")
+    value = value.replace("-", "_")
+    value = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", value)
+    return re.sub(r"_+", "_", value).strip("_").lower()
+
+
+def concept_alias_lookup(alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    lookup: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for variant, canonical in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        canonical_text = str(canonical)
+        lookup[str(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(variant)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[canonical_text] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+        lookup[normalize_family_param(canonical_text)] = canonical_text
+    return lookup
+
+
+def canonicalize_concept(value: Any, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    if not text:
+        return "unclassified_target_parameter"
+    lookup = concept_alias_lookup(alias_data)
+    return (
+        lookup.get(text)
+        or lookup.get(normalize_symbol_match_key(text))
+        or lookup.get(normalize_family_param(text))
+        or text
+    )
+
+
+def aliases_for_canonical(canonical: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = {canonical}
+    for variant, target in (alias_data.get("aliases") or {}).items():
+        if canonicalize_concept(target, alias_data) == canonical:
+            variants.add(str(variant))
+    return sorted(variants)
+
+
+def target_search_variants(canonical: str, raw: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    variants = set(aliases_for_canonical(canonical, alias_data))
+    variants.add(raw)
+    variants.add(canonical)
+    expanded = set()
+    for variant in variants:
+        value = str(variant)
+        expanded.add(value)
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", ""))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", "\\_"))
+        expanded.add(value.replace("_", " "))
+        if value == "L_over_a":
+            expanded.update({"L/a", "L}{a", "L\\over a", "\\frac{L}{a}"})
+        if value in {"mhat_0", "m0_hat"}:
+            expanded.update({"mhat0", "m_hat_0", "m_{\\hat 0}", "\\widehat m_0", "\\widehat m_0^{\\,2}"})
+        if value == "chi_Q":
+            expanded.update({"chiQ", "\\chi_Q", "\\chi_{Q}"})
+        if value == "Sigma0_can":
+            expanded.update({"Sigma0", "Sigma0_can", "Sigma_0_can", "\\Sigma_0", "\\Sigma_0^{\\rm can}"})
+        if value == "P0_target":
+            expanded.update({"P0target", "P_0", "P0", "P_0_target"})
+        if value == "N_Q":
+            expanded.update({"NQ", "NQ_target", "N_Q_target", "N_Q"})
+    return sorted({item for item in expanded if item}, key=lambda item: (-len(item), item))

+def strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key: Any) -> str:
+    key = str(candidate_key or "")
+    key = re.sub(r"^fit_", "", key)
+    key = re.sub(r"^stage_?0*\d+_?", "", key)
+    return key

+def plausible_parameter_names(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
+    values = []
+    for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+        text = str(param or "").strip()
+        if not text:
+            continue
+        if text in {"matched_fingerprint_value", "stale_output", "assert_nonzero", "assert_zero", "paragraph"}:
+            continue
+        canonical = canonicalize_concept(text, alias_data)
+        if canonical not in values:
+            values.append(canonical)
+    return values
+
+
+def key_rule_target(candidate_key: str, alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None, bool]:
+    key = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    for rule in alias_data.get("key_rules") or []:
+        pattern = str(rule.get("pattern") or "")
+        if pattern and re.search(pattern, key, re.IGNORECASE):
+            target = str(rule.get("target") or "")
+            if target:
+                return target, f"candidate_key rule /{pattern}/", bool(rule.get("multi_target"))
+    return None, None, False
+
+
+def parse_primary_target(entry: dict[str, Any], alias_data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    candidate_key = str(entry.get("candidate_key") or entry.get("id") or "")
+    key_suffix = strip_stage_key_prefix(candidate_key)
+    raw_target, basis, rule_multi = key_rule_target(candidate_key, alias_data)
+    resolution_confidence = "high"
+    low_reasons: list[str] = []
+    if raw_target:
+        raw = raw_target
+    else:
+        normalized_key = normalize_symbol_match_key(key_suffix)
+        matches = []
+        for param in entry.get("parameter_names") or []:
+            param_text = str(param or "")
+            candidate_forms = {normalize_symbol_match_key(param_text), normalize_family_param(param_text)}
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param_text, alias_data)
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_symbol_match_key(canonical))
+            candidate_forms.add(normalize_family_param(canonical))
+            if any(form and re.search(rf"(?:^|_){re.escape(form)}(?:_|$)", normalized_key) for form in candidate_forms):
+                matches.append((param_text, canonical))
+        canonical_matches = []
+        for _raw, canonical in matches:
+            if canonical not in canonical_matches:
+                canonical_matches.append(canonical)
+        if len(canonical_matches) == 1:
+            raw = matches[0][0]
+            basis = "candidate_key matched manifest parameter"
+        else:
+            params = plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data)
+            if params:
+                raw = params[0]
+                basis = "parameter_names fallback because candidate_key was uninformative"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("key_uninformative")
+                if len(params) > 1:
+                    low_reasons.append("multiple_plausible_targets")
+            else:
+                raw = "unclassified_target_parameter"
+                basis = "no resolvable candidate_key or parameter_names target"
+                resolution_confidence = "low"
+                low_reasons.append("no_plausible_target")
+    primary = canonicalize_concept(raw, alias_data)
+    additional: list[str] = []
+    key_patterns = alias_data.get("multi_target_key_patterns") or []
+    key_multi = rule_multi or any(re.search(str(pattern), key_suffix, re.IGNORECASE) for pattern in key_patterns)
+    if key_multi:
+        for param in plausible_parameter_names(entry, alias_data):
+            canonical = canonicalize_concept(param, alias_data)
+            if canonical != primary and canonical not in additional:
+                additional.append(canonical)
+    return {
+        "raw_primary_target_parameter": raw,
+        "primary_target_parameter": primary,
+        "resolution_basis": basis or "candidate_key parse",
+        "target_resolution_confidence": resolution_confidence,
+        "low_reasons": low_reasons,
+        "multi_target": bool(additional),
+        "additional_target_parameters": additional,
+    }
